window_months: Feb 1 to Sep 30 local time, each year
primary_statistic: D = [R(post) - R(pre)] for foundation model minus the same for classical control; R = mean MAE of model / mean MAE of weekly seasonal naive
decision_rule: Claim consistency with contamination only if D > 0 with 95% block bootstrap (weekly blocks) interval excluding 0 at both 24h and 168h horizons AND the sign holds when window boundaries shift by plus and minus 6 months. Otherwise report a null result.
assumption: pre = likely inside pretraining data, post = after release; to be verified against model documentation
sensitivity_rules: S1: drop all origins before Feb 15 local time in every year (early season cold snaps)
S2: shift window boundaries by plus and minus 6 months where data allow

amendments.text: After a smoke test on 8 origins: (1) each horizon (24h, 168h) gets its own forecast call for both foundation models, no slicing; (2) Chronos Bolt library warns that quality may degrade beyond 64 steps, so 168h Bolt results carry that stated limitation; (3) Chronos Bolt run in float32.
POST HOC, exploratory, added after seeing primary results: placebo D across all 21 year pairs to gauge between year noise. Not part of the pre registered decision rule.
